rows.tag: 1(a) KHK gear ratings under their stated conditions
rows.stated_conditions: KHK 2025 spur gear catalogue (JGMA 401-01 / 402-01 metal gears): mating gear of the same number of teeth, 600 rpm, over 1e7 cycles, uniform load, bidirectional load (2/3 of sigma_Flim already taken), 100 cSt (50 C) oil, symmetric support. DS (Lewis): sigma_b 3.5 kgf/mm2 at m 1 (40 C, grease), 100 rpm; mate and direction not stated. Recorded per gear in the catalogue (specs.rating_conditions).

checks.load direction: the train reverses: back-driven crank torque 8.7 N m on v18 (S/r9/split-v18.json crankBack_max). Metal: KHK's 2/3 already in its bending figure, no further factor (JGMA 402 has no reversing reduction for surface). DS: the plastic method has no reversing rule, so JGMA 401's 2/3 is applied.
checks.mating gear: corrected by JGMA 402-01 eq. 10.17 (d01 i/(i+1), d01 the pinion) and JGMA 401-01 Y-epsilon = 1/eps_alpha (contact ratio by formula, pinned to KHK Table 10.1). A pinion gains (x1.38 for 18:40); a wheel loses (x0.62 for a 40-tooth wheel on an 18-tooth pinion).
checks.support: KH-beta (KHK Table 10.11): every stage plane sits 11-82% along the 65 mm plate span (sims/avis-shared/model.js gearPlanes, not this workstream's), none at mid-span; KHK states no criterion for its 'rugged shaft' column, so the 'weak shaft' column is used (1.46 at b/d01 0.56 against 1.04 rated).
checks.speed: KV by its band (no credit for a lower band; a higher band than rated has no resolved KHK-grade row: half); ZV by Fig. 10.5, read at its first value below 1 m/s (KHK's own 600 rpm ratings need the same reading). DS: KHK's plastic speed factor KV.
checks.lubricant: Shell Omala S2 GX 220 on the steel stages, about 127 cSt at 50 C by ASTM D341 from the published 220 / 19.4 cSt (no ZL credit); Molykote EM-30L (PAO grease) on the Duracon meshes, as KHK advises for plastic gears. Their grams sit in the 15% margin.
checks.cycles and impact: no life credit (KL = KHL = 1); the rating is applied to the simulated instantaneous peak torque, gusts included (KO = 1).
checks.material: DS on DS: KM 0.75 (KHK plastic method; the catalogue states no mate, taken as metal).
checks.scope: KHK states the JGMA method for module 1.5-25 and pitch diameter 25 mm and up; these gears are module 1 (as are KHK's own catalogue ratings).

rows.tag: 2 what sets the peak crank torque (v18, M4 nominal and aero0.9 mass1.05 cg5mm, 200 seeds)
rows.file: S/r9/split-v18.json (flight.js telemetry crankTorqueAero / Gravity / Spring / Inertia at the peak instant)
rows.at_peak_crank_torque: aero 136% (p10-p90 130-143%), wing inertia -31% (-37 to -24%: it relieves the peak), gravity -6%
rows.peak_motor_current: 53.0 A, a start transient at t = 0.06 s (rotor and gear acceleration 6.3 N m crank-equivalent); 26 of 200 runs peak in the first second; the in-flight peak is 47.4 A; 2 s RMS max 23.4 A against 36 A continuous
rows.verdict: inertia is not a large share at the peak: the brief's condition for item 3 does not hold

rows.tag: 3 elastic storage (screen only, idealised linear rocker springs, not adopted)

rows.none: crank max 14.06, p50 12.83, back 8.66, motor 2 s RMS 23.4 A
rows.k 3, T_mid 0 (stiffness only): max 14.99 (higher: it removes the inertial relief)

rows.parts: Lee Spring stock torsion springs top out at 43.29 in-lb (4.9 N m, LTL135H 30); maximum = torque to the maximum suggested deflection, no cycle life stated; a +/-19 deg rocker needs a preloaded or opposed pair (S/research/round9-drive.json Q4)
rows.verdict: not adopted: inertia is not the peak's driver, and a down-biased spring trims the maximum by 2% (the median by 13%), which does not close the gear-rating gap

rows.a_motor_flat: no maker-cut flat stated for the Cobra C-2820 shaft (Innov8tive pages; a replacement-shaft photo shows a flat at the rotor end only) or any substitute read (Scorpion SII-3020, T-Motor AT2820, AXI 2820 V3, Dualsky ECO 2820C, Leopard LC3542, Hacker A30): route (a) fails
rows.set_screw_strength: ISO 898-5 specifies hardness only and states it does not specify tensile or shear strength; no maker publishes a metric set-screw shear or holding rating (Holo-Krome / Unbrako give inch axial holding power, friction, +/-30%): a set-screw form fit has no published screw strength, so routes (a) and (b) cannot be rated
rows.c_keyed: keyed module-1 KHK bores start at 8 mm (MSGA/SSA J8) and S1K keyed + set-screw bores at 24 teeth (10 mm); the motor shaft (5 mm, round) cannot take one. The rated train above already keys every steel gear; its three Duracon gears (DSF1-20 on the motor, DS1-30, DS1-60) stay unrated fixings
rows.d_maxon_faulhaber: maxon GP 52 C 2-stage 15 / 22.5 N m 620 g, 3-stage 30 / 45 N m 770 g; GP 42 C 3-stage 15 / 22.5 N m 460 g; EC 60 flat 200 W 360 g; lightest qualifying pair EC 60 flat + GP 52 C 43:1, about 1130 g against the 578.5 g drive group: the reviewer's estimate is confirmed (several hundred grams heavier)

rows.against_cfd: the cfd points (matched on v17: 5.9 / 6.9 / 6.2 deg) bracket v19's mid-span strips from below only: no strip exceeds 6.9 (no upward extrapolation); most strips sit below 5.9 deg and would hold the smallest point's value
